question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you like to travel during spring break?
options: Maybe if someone else goes with me.
I prefer to veg at home.

question_options.question: Have you been to Hawaii before?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE. It's not that hard. You won't mess up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it'll be tons of fun! There's a lot of marine life in the ocean that you won't want to miss.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's all the iridescent fish and the colorful coral...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about the sharks, and the stinging jellyfish, and the eels?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eels?! Aren't those like snakes in the sea?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh! Well, forget that. I don't want to run into any eels...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy, are you coming in or not?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, not anymore! I'm going to sit with $ZOE on the beach for awhile.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Remember your New Year's resolution, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The one where you said you wanted to be more adventurous?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is another chance to try.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You can't mess up here. And if you get into any trouble, Colt and I will be around to help you out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for reminding me of that, Sam. I think I'm ready to try snorkeling now!
The girls enter the water and look at the fish.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally, you join us. How's the water, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is great! I'm in a school of fishes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ooh! I think one just tickled my foot!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm glad you're enjoying yourself.
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ready to head back to the beach now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, let's go dry off and get some sun.
The clerk escorts the students to their rooms where they turn in for the night.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Anything else you'd like? A glass-bottom boat ride? Tickets to the pie-eating contest? A tour to see the dolphins on the other side of the island?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Dolphins!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, that's okay.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No dolphins...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We have to build houses tomorrow morning. We'll just go to our rooms please.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Right this way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This can't be happening! I booked those rooms weeks in advance!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I have, like, forty very tired, `very grumpy` students waiting to check-in!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I have, like, forty very tired, [color=#3b78e2][i]very grumpy[/i][/color] students waiting to check-in!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: `Forty?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Forty?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oops, the hotel isn't supposed to know that we were cramming so many people into rooms to save money...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: I was going to offer the penthouse suite for the trouble we caused you...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: But your party is too large! We have strict limits on the number of guests per room.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Now, I'm happy to give you different rooms than what you've asked for, but I'll have to charge you additional rooms in order to accommodate your entire party.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess we have no choice.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Way to go, `Sam.` Now we have to pay `more` for `smaller` rooms.
nodes.text_bbcode: Way to go, [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam.[/i][/color] Now we have to pay [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] for [color=#3b78e2][i]smaller[/i][/color] rooms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: These things happen. It's okay.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: You're too kind.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Ah, and it seems that there are no rooms left at the regular rate...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Since it's our mistake, let us make it up to you. We'll upgrade your rooms for free to a wonderful penthouse suite which should accommodate your entire party.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: We like to keep our customers happy.
The car turns into the airport!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for the good direction-giving, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Happy to help.
A few minutes later, Howard and the caravan pull up to the curb and unload their luggage.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't see anything that resembles an airport.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, I'm pretty sure those directions were right... Maybe if we just keep going straight for awhile?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, if that's what you say, Sam...
One plane flight and taxi ride later, Sam and the rest of the student body arrive at the hotel late that evening.
At the front hotel desk, a clerk greets the group.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: You must be W.H.A.L.E.! Welcome to Hawaii!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! Can we get our room reservations now?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Of course!
The clerk starts typing furiously at his computer.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: I'm terribly sorry... We are expecting you today, but it seems the specific rooms you booked are not available.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: It must be some sort of clerical error...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That sounds wrong to me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. I've never driven to the airport before, but I think this is the right way...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, make that right up here...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That sounds wrong to me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. I've never driven to the airport before, but I think this is the right way...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sure that's the way!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Make a right on...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, um... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... Now what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, um... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... Now what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That doesn't seem right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you saying you don't trust me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, of course not... Where to next?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Taking 101 South. Where to next?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That doesn't seem right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you saying you don't trust me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, of course not... Where to next?
Outside, a car horn honks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Looks like the car caravan is here!
Sam's mom appears at the door.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Your ride is outside. You girls all packed up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're ready to go! Bye, Aunt Cathy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Bye, Mom!
Sam and $ZOE jump into Howard's car.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, Sam, where am I driving? We're leading the caravan to the airport, and I don't want to steer them wrong.
Sam checks her phone for directions.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here. Got it. Once you get to the freeway, take the exit for Highway `101` South...
nodes.text_bbcode: Here. Got it. Once you get to the freeway, take the exit for Highway [color=#3b78e2][i]101[/i][/color] South...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then Highway `380` East... Then you turn right on `Airport Blvd!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Then Highway [color=#3b78e2][i]380[/i][/color] East... Then you turn right on [color=#3b78e2][i]Airport Blvd![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard eases his car into traffic.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what kind of vacation did you girls plan for us?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A fun one! We're staying at a nice hotel... Though we're cramming a lot of people into each room to save money.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And what about the activities? Making out on the beach? Wet bikini contests?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think you need to plan 'making out on the beach.'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Priorities. It's important to schedule these things in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hah. But, Colt, this isn't all fun and games. We are representing W.H.A.L.E., so we have to construct some houses and do some relief work.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That sounds charitable.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...But `after that,` we can hit the beach and do all the things you want.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...But [color=#3b78e2][i]after that,[/i][/color] we can hit the beach and do all the things you want.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `All` the things?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]All[/i][/color] the things?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't want to know... Hey, Sam, I'm getting to the freeway. Where do I go?
Sam checks her phone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm out of batteries! What were the directions again?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't worry so much about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't need a passport to go to Hawaii, driver's licenses can be replaced, and some couples are meant to break up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And our plane flights are booked, our hotel rooms are reserved, and we're going in a big group as part of an organization.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All we have to do is build some houses, swim in the ocean, and lay on the beach!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hawaii is totally safe! It's like we're not even leaving home.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I heard, like, only six high school kids get kidnapped `a year!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I heard, like, only six high school kids get kidnapped [color=#3b78e2][i]a year![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Six?!` `Kidnapped?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Six?![/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]Kidnapped?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, we'll be on an island. It's not like the kidnappers would get away, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Unless they had boats!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mentioning kidnapping is where I definitely went wrong...
Centerscore High is on spring break, and the students are ready for vacation!
Can you help Sam deal with everyone's travel troubles, or will the trip be too hard to handle? And who's going to break up? Let's find out!
At home, Sam and $ZOE pack for their vacation.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is so exciting, $ZOE. I can't believe that we're going to Hawaii!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Although I don't know how we ended up planning a trip for `everyone...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Although I don't know how we ended up planning a trip for [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I do...
One afternoon, at a meeting of the school's environmental club, W.H.A.L.E...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Spring break is coming up, and as director of this club, I think it's a great opportunity to sink our teeth into a great project. Any ideas?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As club treasurer, I vote we go to Hawaii and build houses for the needy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Taylor, last time I checked, we didn't have the funds to buy `supplies`, much less go on vacation.
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor, last time I checked, we didn't have the funds to buy [color=#3b78e2][i]supplies[/i][/color], much less go on vacation.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We didn't have funds before because I've been saving them for spring break!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You mean, there have been funds all along? We could've used those to implement a recycling program... Or grow a garden... Or build solar panels and reduce energy consumption...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oops? The point is, W.H.A.L.E. can sponsor our trip to Hawaii, and we can hit the beach and tan... After we clean the houses or build the beach or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I know just the girl to plan the entire thing! Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh? Is this why you had all the cheerleaders join W.H.A.L.E.?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I want to see dolphins!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All we need is the school president and the director of W.H.A.L.E. to sign off on it, and we're good to go. What do you think, Denni?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But Taylor, we could actually use that money to fund all our projects for the rest of the year!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not if I already bought non-refundable tickets...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I guess I can't turn down a trip to Hawaii...
And in the room where the student council meets...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You want the student council to sign off on W.H.A.L.E.'s trip to Hawaii, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I guess we can't turn down a charitable cause....

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Indeed. This sounds like an excellent opportunity... For a vacation...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Who said you were invited?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you and the cheerleaders are going, Sammy, then obviously, I am...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And if $ZOE's going, then so am I.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If Howard and Hector are going, I'm going. I'll bring Dinah too!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We can all go!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And then the nerds followed Brendan, so the rebels wanted to join in as well, and that's how the entire school is going on a trip to Hawaii.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's cool that we're part of this opportunity though.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but we planned the entire thing. What if it's a total disaster?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if someone loses their passport or their driver's license or their girlfriend?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE...
Sam climbs on top of the chair, then the table.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hope Paige is distracting the bouncer...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And then I went to the mall and spent a couple hundred on this dress...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But don't you think it looks nice?

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: It looks like a dress.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks! The saleslady said so too.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I can just lift it off the bull horns... Yes!
Sam lifts the sombrero off the wall and climbs down, blending into the crowd.
A few minutes later, Paige comes back.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You did it!
Paige takes the hat from Sam as they walk to the back door.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nice work, Sam. You're the best! This is a fantastic hat!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm sorry I intruded on your vacation, but I'm happy you came out tonight!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Aren't you going to put the hat on?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, Sam, even you should know that you don't wear stolen goods in the store you stole it from!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks for the great time!
Paige and Prissy leave the club.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good night!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was actually surprisingly fun!
Sam hangs out with the cheerleaders until finally...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yawn.... Howard and I are going back early. Do you and Colt want to go back?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good idea, $ZOE. We have our plane to catch tomorrow.
They walk back to the hotel.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I hope you're right.
Sam leads the group to the beach on the other side of the island.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't see her! `I don't see her!` Where's Amanda?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't see her! [color=#e23b3b][i]I don't see her![/i][/color] Where's Amanda?!

nodes.text: Sam looks out at the water where the dolphins are playing. Amanda swims along beside them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hector, she's over there. She swimming with the fishes...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's `dead?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: She's [color=#e23b3b][i]dead?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, she's over there in the inlet... Swimming with the dolphins!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, Sam, that was a little misleading.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, but she's fine, Hector! She's doing what she told us she wanted to all along.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, is that you? Come in and swim with me! You have to meet all my dolphin pals!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This one's named Lara, and this one's Burt, and this one is Pony...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Pony has body issues...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda, we should get some sleep. Our flight is tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, right... Goodbye, dolphins!
Amanda walks onto shore where Hector envelops her in a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, Amanda, I totally forgot that's what you wanted to do.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's okay. I got to swim with them anyway!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Glad Amanda's safe, but can we get sleep now?
The next morning, Sam wakes up and looks at her alarm clock...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're going to be late for our plane!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I hope you're right.
The group of students heads to the park and search...
And search...
And keep searching!
At last...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had a feeling something bad would happen on our trip. We lost Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda! Amanda!!!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Polo!
Amanda walks into view where Hector envelops her in a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Where were you?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I was swimming with the dolphins! Don't you remember, you said I could go later?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Amanda, we were looking for you the entire night!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sorry. Dolphins don't sleep!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or... Do they?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry, Amanda, I totally forgot that's what you really wanted to do.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, the time for apologies is later.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right now, we have an hour to get back to the hotel, pack, and get to the airport, so we don't miss our plane...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I hope you're right.
The group of students heads to the city center and search...
And search...
And keep searching!
At last...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had a feeling something bad would happen on our trip. We lost Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda! Amanda!!!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Polo!
Amanda walks into view where Hector envelops her in a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Where were you?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I was swimming with the dolphins! Don't you remember, you said I could go later?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Amanda, we were looking for you the entire night!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sorry. Dolphins don't sleep!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or... Do they?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry, Amanda, I totally forgot that's what you really wanted to do.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, the time for apologies is later.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right now, we have an hour to get back to the hotel, pack, and get to the airport, so we don't miss our plane...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I can just lean over and grab it with...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ahhhhh!
Sam loses her balance and falls to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: You there! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, wait, we were just having a great conversation about me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't mind her. She was just looking for, uh, something!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great cover.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Uh-huh.
The bouncer hauls Sam to her feet.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: I'm going to have to ask you to leave. I can't have troublemakers in the club.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry.
The bouncer escorts Sam and Paige out of the club.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This sucks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, getting caught is terrible.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I wasn't talking about that. You didn't get me the hat!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? That's what you're worried about? We nearly got mauled by the bouncer a second ago, and you're concerned about a hat?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't be dramatic, Sam. It's just... You used to be more reliable. The Sam `I` knew would've taken that hat without even `me` knowing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't be dramatic, Sam. It's just... You used to be more reliable. The Sam [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] knew would've taken that hat without even [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] knowing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, I'm tired. I'm going to go home now. Bye, Sam.
Paige leaves Sam standing alone on the beach.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That didn't turn out well.
$ZOE, Howard, and Colt come up to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I saw what happened. Let's go back to the hotel. At least we can go to sleep early now. We have our plane flight to catch tomorrow, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess...
They walk back to the hotel.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Paige will get herself into trouble without backup. She needs all the help she can get.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, I'm totally taking advantage of this. Come on!
Paige drags Sam over to the sombrero hanging on the wall.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, the only person facing this wall is the bouncer. I'm going to talk to him, and you're going to take the hat!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All you have to do is climb on top of the table and grab it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's way out of my reach!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then stretch!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Since when did you become such a spoiler, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're not as fun as you used to be.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And if you're not going to help me, then I'm going to do it myself.
Sam watches Paige stalk over to the sombrero hanging on the wall.
Paige climbs the table, reaches for the hat, and snags it!

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Hey, girl, what are you doing? Come with me... And take `all` your friends with you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, girl, what are you doing? Come with me... And take [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] your friends with you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-oh...
The bouncer drags Paige, Sam, and the rest of the Centerscore group outside.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: And stay out! If I see you come back around, I'm going to crush your heads like watermelons!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Way to go, `Sam.` I just started dancing with one of the cute guys.
nodes.text_bbcode: Way to go, [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam.[/i][/color] I just started dancing with one of the cute guys.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, and this freshman was going to buy me coconut juice... In a coconut!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, it's not her fault.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, if anything, it's `Paige's.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, if anything, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]Paige's.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? If you'd backed me up, we could've taken the hat without anyone knowing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sam, if you'd stuck with `your` friend, we'd still be there partying. I'm heading back to my hotel.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, if you'd stuck with [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] friend, we'd still be there partying. I'm heading back to my hotel.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Me too.
All the students depart, leaving Sam, Colt, $ZOE and Howard standing alone in the sand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought you did the right thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Small consolation there, but thanks, $ZOE.
They walk back to the hotel.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: 111 Fake Street? You either have a lazy forger or an unfortunate street name.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm pretty unfortunate.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: You answered all my questions.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: All right, Miss Flores.
The bouncer turns to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: You. Troublemaker. What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My name? Fakey McMakerson! January 19! 222 Boulevard Avenue!

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Go in. All right, who's next?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We've got our `IDs`. Stan Danstand, December 28, 333 Street Road!
nodes.text_bbcode: We've got our [color=#e23b3b][i]IDs[/i][/color]. Stan Danstand, December 28, 333 Street Road!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Bonnie Petite, February 22, 911 Emergency Road!

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Ugh, you kids. Just go in. The whole lot of you.
Justin holds up a camera!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Mind if I take a picture of this moment? It's the first time I've ever been in a club!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You are so weird, Justin.
The Centerscore students walk inside.
Inside the club...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You got in! I knew you had it in you. Come on, let's start dancing!

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: You're...

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Right!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, it is my birthday. Comes back around every year.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Where do you live?

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: All right, so you know your name. Big deal.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: What's your birthday?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, shove off, Prissy. Sam's here! In Hawaii! Isn't it funny that we'd be on vacation at exactly the same time?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, we are in the same school district...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. It's so great! We should totally hang out! I heard there's a party we can crash tonight...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm glad to see you too, Paige. But I don't want to crash a party.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? But it's an eighteen-and-up club! It's going to be amazing. It has college guys we can pick up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know I'm still here, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm just kidding. You can come too, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I didn't bring any party clothes...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, it's `Hawaii.` You can go anywhere in your bikini.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]Hawaii.[/i][/color] You can go anywhere in your bikini.

nodes.text: At that moment, the other cheerleaders walk up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What was that I heard about an eighteen-and-up club and college guys?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Paige, this is Taylor, the head cheerleader at our school. And the rest of the cheerleading team.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm talking about Club Luau. There's a huge battle between fraternities, so there are going to be a ton of cute guys there.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooh, I heard about that! The MAN fraternity is hosting a hot party to out-battle DUDE!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That sounds way cool!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I want to go! Take me with you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, the more girls the better! They'll be more likely to let us in.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, Sam. It'll be just like old times. You, me, a huge party to crash! We'll have so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wanted to spend time sitting on the beach, not getting into trouble with Paige. I stopped partying like that when I left Monarch. But if everyone else wants to go...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, sure, let's do it.
That night, all the Centerscore students head to Club Luau and wait in the line to get in.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm so excited. There will be college guys at this party!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about Bryce?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Every time I think about him, I think about how I was supposed to be the `Queen of Hearts,` but we all know how `that` turned out.
nodes.text_bbcode: Every time I think about him, I think about how I was supposed to be the [color=#3b78e2][i]Queen of Hearts,[/i][/color] but we all know how [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] turned out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Forget Bryce. He was just a date for the dance. Nothing serious. I'm ready for someone new and exciting...
And close to the front of the line, Sam and $ZOE wait with their dates and the Monarch Prep girls.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So Sam's a cheerleader now? And one of the most popular girls at school? She didn't tell me that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not surprised. Sam was one of the meanest Monarch Prep girls. Everyone must be afraid of her at Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Afraid of Sam? Not at all. She's sweet! Everyone knows her as the school matchmaker.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? I have a hard time believing `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? I have a hard time believing [color=#3b78e2][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I'm shocked people actually hang out with her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Sam, we're getting close to the club entrance. How are we going to get in?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: With the proper `identification`, of course. For a price, I can get everyone in. I've sold two already!
nodes.text_bbcode: With the proper [color=#e23b3b][i]identification[/i][/color], of course. For a price, I can get everyone in. I've sold two already!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, you know how I feel about you using a fake ID.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Says the girl who made me one for Valentine's Day. Don't worry so much, babe. Besides, don't you want to see yours?
Sam snatches the fake ID that Colt is holding up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, do I look like a `Consuela Flores` to you? And what's with these details?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, do I look like a [color=#3b78e2][i]Consuela Flores[/i][/color] to you? And what's with these details?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't live on `111 Fake Street,` and my birthday's nowhere near the `end of June!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't live on [color=#3b78e2][i]111 Fake Street,[/i][/color] and my birthday's nowhere near the [color=#3b78e2][i]end of June![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The point of the fake ID is that the details aren't real, babe.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, I can't use this. It's illegal. Can't we try to think of another way in?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, Sam, don't be such a downer. You're the girl that snuck out of your dorm past curfew to party downtown!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I'm not the girl you remember.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're right. The Sam `I` knew would never have this much trouble getting into a club. And she'd never be too much of a wuss to use a fake ID.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're right. The Sam [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] knew would never have this much trouble getting into a club. And she'd never be too much of a wuss to use a fake ID.

nodes.text: The group approaches the front door where a large, burly bouncer stands.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: IDs, please.
Prissy slips the bouncer a large bill of money.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I can assure you, sir, that me and my friend Paige here are perfectly legit.
The bouncer lets them pass.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See you inside, goody-goody.
Angrily, Sam hands the bouncer her fake ID, and he looks at it closely.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: You won't mind answering some questions, will you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course not.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Oh really? Better than a three-story beach house mansion where the suites are made of gold?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uhm... No... What would you possibly do in a room made of gold?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Wouldn't you like to know?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're staying in a luxurious, five-star resort overlooking the ocean with a heated pool.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You guys have a working pool? Prissy's dad's house doesn't have one.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, a mansion without a heated pool? How lame.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You don't need a pool when you have beach access, but fine, I guess your resort's not totally pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I feel a lot better. Thanks for cheering me up, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am a cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ha ha. I'm going to find $Scott now. I'll keep what you said in mind.
Angie takes off towards the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You might want to ditch the towel!
Angie takes off her towel and runs into the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Glad she's feeling more comfortable with herself.
Angie tries to edge the other cheerleaders out.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uhm... Uh... $Scott?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, $Scott, didn't you promise the cheerleaders new uniforms this year?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, we'd look so much hotter if the skirts were just a little shorter...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ha ha, ladies...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh hey, Angie, I didn't see you there...
Angie walks right up to the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Taylor, I like your bikini. Maria, you're looking nice.
The popular girls turn from $Scott to Angie.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Thanks, Angie!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aren't you sweet?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: There you are, Angie...
Angie takes off her glasses and walks towards $Scott's voice...
Only to trip in the shallow surf!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Steady there. You okay? Why aren't you wearing your glasses?
$Scott takes Angie's glasses and puts them back on for her.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I thought it would make me cute.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Aw, Anj, you `are` cute. Glasses or no.
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw, Anj, you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] cute. Glasses or no.

nodes.text: $Scott drapes his arm around Angie.
Angie giggles.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Anj, you're lookin' pretty sweet in that suit.
Angie splashes $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Whoa there!
$Scott sweeps Angie up in a kiss!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is the matchmaker at it again?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just this time. I think Angie is much happier.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam. I'm not sure I can follow your advice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's okay. I don't think I was very helpful.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It just made me realize that there are a lot of things I need to change about myself.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I just don't know where to start. See you later, Sam and $ZOE.
Angie stands up, taking her beach towel with her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That probably could've gone better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you tried.
The next afternoon, Sam and $ZOE settle down on their beach towels.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ahhh... Finally, some sun...
Colt plops on the sand next to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hello, beautiful. You're looking fine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So are you.
Colt wraps his arm around Sam.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's say we get out of here and...
Colt leans into kiss Sam, but at that moment, they get splashed with a huge spray of water!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What the...?! Who did that?!
Sam and Colt whirl around to find...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Paige?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who else? Ha ha. You two are looking a little soaked.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You didn't have to splash us.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're not going to do anything back? The Sam `I` remember would've thrown gotten even by now.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not going to do anything back? The Sam [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] remember would've thrown gotten even by now.

nodes.text: Just then, Prissy comes up.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Paige! I was totally looking forward to parasailing on my dad's new sports boat... Why'd you run off?
Prissy sees Sam.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ugh, it's you. I didn't expect to see you here. And your boyfriend's with you? I'm surprised they let a convict like him cross state lines.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, I'm not a convict. 'Convicted' means you were caught.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Whatever. I see you're still wearing that lame, yard-sale bikini, Sam. Don't you know that color expired, like, three seasons ago?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't you ever stop talking, Prissy? Why are you girls here?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: What do you think? We're on vacation. And we're staying in my dad's fancy house. What back-end hovel did you end up staying in?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Take off my glasses?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, they do it all the time in movies. You take off your glasses, and you're instantly hotter and flirtier!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I don't know... Can't I keep my glasses on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Guys like eye contacts.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I thought that was eye contact.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just go with it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Giggle?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it's a great flirting technique. Guys like it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It lets them know you're having fun with them.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I do have fun with $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then it'll be easy.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh, Sam? What should I do to be flirtier?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uhm, er... Never wear red and pink together?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm not wearing either of those colors.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry. Forget what I just said.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway, after you get the girls away from $Scott, flirt with him a little.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Flirt with him how?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How did you get him interested in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I helped organize the best party ever so he could remain President and serve the students of Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, it doesn't have to be as big as that. Flirt small.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Talk to $Scott? But I talk to him all the time.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And it doesn't work. I can't compete when Taylor is asking $Scott whether or not her bikini is too small.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got a point.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Why would I want to talk to the other girl?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Think about it, if you're talking to her, she can't talk to $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And if I talk to her, I can assess her threat level and discover the ways in which she and $Scott are incompatible.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Something like that.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it comes from having Colt for a boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What was that, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You should jump in and... Be yourself.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That might be true, but that's not specific enough to help me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ooh! Here's another tip! When you're worried that $Scott is talking `too` much to another girl...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh! Here's another tip! When you're worried that $Scott is talking [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] much to another girl...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All you need to do is jump in and...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're cute. And you have something most of the cheerleaders don't...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: A one-piece suit? Terrible vision? Spreadsheets detailing contingency plans when everything goes horribly wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, a brain! We're not dumb, but we're not as smart as you. Being smart can be hot.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I know I'm smart, and that's a good thing. But it's nice hearing that from you.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: My 20/200 vision, my pale complexion, and my poor sense of humor?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: There's also my...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, I'm stopping you right there. I don't want you to feel bad about yourself.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: A little late for that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here let me try again...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Were you going to say something?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uhm, er... Uhm... Don't wear white after Labor Day?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That doesn't quite help me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let me try again...
Sam and $ZOE walk away from the surf towards the grove of trees where the cheerleaders have set up umbrellas.
Angie sits there sadly, wrapped in a towel despite the heat.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Hey, Angie, what's up? Why aren't you out in the water with everyone else?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No reason. It's just that... $Scott's been hanging around the other cheerleaders all day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So? He hangs out with them all the time at school.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's just different now. I can't compete with cheerleaders in tiny bikinis.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're intimidated?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Maybe a litte. I don't know how you deal with it.
Angie gestures to Colt who is also splashing with the other popular girls in the water.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Do you have any advice?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sounds like Angie needs a pep talk...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know, Angie. You and $Scott have been together for a while. Nothing's going to happen with any of the other girls.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think you'll feel better if you're more confident...
In fact, you were so close to getting that shiny, bonus scene!
Play again to get a perfect score!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe I stole a sombrero to make Paige happy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I didn't like snorkeling that much, but the water was nice to look at.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And we had a nice hotel. So what if we had to pay for extra rooms? At least they were classy.
Sam and the group race to the airport and run to their plane!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: We made it! Centerscore, here we come!
A couple hours later, back in Centerscore...
The students waits for their shuttle to the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: All in all that was an awesome vacation. I can't believe it's over.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good job planning, Sam. Building houses `and` going to the beach to see all the cute guys was fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: Good job planning, Sam. Building houses [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] going to the beach to see all the cute guys was fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can you believe the Monarch Prep girls were there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But we survived them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And at least they didn't hit on Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it could've been worse. I wouldn't put it past her to try to push me into a crime spree next for the fun of it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tee hee.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I still don't forgive you for winning Queen of Hearts, Sam...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you did get me into an eighteen-and-up club.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So maybe I won't be so hard on you at practice when we get back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks!
Looks like everyone had a really great time on their spring break!
But the story's not quite over yet...
In another part of Centerscore, $Scott drops Angie off at her house.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Anj, you've been awfully quiet the entire trip back. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm... I'm... Sniffle... Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, what's wrong? Why are you crying?
$Scott reaches out to Angie, but she recoils.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, I'm sorry. We... We can't be together anymore.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What? Angie, what are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm breaking up with you, $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're breaking up with me? I don't understand. We just had a lot of fun in Hawaii together.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Things are going well... Aren't they? If it's anything I did, I'll make it up to you!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Just stop, $Scott. I'm... I've made my decision. Both decisions actually.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Both decisions?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm also tendering my resignation as school council Secretary.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie, I don't think I can lose you as my girlfriend `and` my secretary...
nodes.text_bbcode: Angie, I don't think I can lose you as my girlfriend [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] my secretary...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So that's it then? Don't I get to know why?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I don't even think I can give you that.
Angie opens her door and runs from the car.
Whoa, Angie broke up with $Scott? Who would've seen that one coming? Find out why in an upcoming Surviving High School episode!
But for now, you played a great game!

Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: On the curb outside their hotel, Sam hails a cab, and a taxi stops at the curb.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We have just enough time to...
Suddenly, someone grabs Sam and pulls her into the taxi!
The taxi begins speeding off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Where did she go?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Sammy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Sammy![/i][/color]

nodes.text: In the speeding taxi...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What the...?! Where am I?
Sam spins around and sees...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt?!

nodes.speaker: Domingo FLorentine
nodes.text: I am no horse.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, wait, you're not Colt. I know you!  You're the real Domingo Florentine!

nodes.speaker: Domingo FLorentine
nodes.text: Ah, so you do remember me, my sweet rose, my beautiful flower, my dear `Consuela Flores.` I knew it was you from the moment I laid eyes on you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ah, so you do remember me, my sweet rose, my beautiful flower, my dear [color=#e23b3b][i]Consuela Flores.[/i][/color] I knew it was you from the moment I laid eyes on you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, wait, wait. Consuela?

nodes.speaker: Domingo FLorentine
nodes.text: My dearest betrothed, you are even more beautiful than when I last saw you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Betrothed?!` Doesn't that mean 'engaged'?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Betrothed?![/i][/color] Doesn't that mean 'engaged'?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've made a mistake. I'm not who you think I am!

nodes.speaker: Domingo FLorentine
nodes.text: There is no mistake... My man at Club Luau informed me as soon as you gave him your ID.

nodes.speaker: Domingo FLorentine
nodes.text: I told you to move away from 111 Fake Street! No one believes that you live there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, really, I'm not Consuela Florentine, or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Domingo FLorentine
nodes.text: `Not yet`, you aren't!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Not yet[/i][/color], you aren't!

nodes.speaker: Domingo FLorentine
nodes.text: I've searched for you long and hard these past few years, and now that I've found you, no one can take you away from me!

nodes.speaker: Domingo FLorentine
nodes.text: We'll be in bliss with the money I've acquired from my diamond heists...

nodes.speaker: Domingo FLorentine
nodes.text: And I'm sure you'll be very happy when we make off for the non-extraditing country Paraguay!
Sam's engaged to a Colt-look-alike named Domingo Florentine who thinks she's the real Consuela Flores?! This is just weird!
Try again and see if you can get Sam home next time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, you guys! I think we'll just make it on time for boarding.
Sam runs around the corner... To find the boarding counter closed!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We missed our flight back?

nodes.speaker: Airline Agent
nodes.text: You wanted the CA-1432 flight back to California?

nodes.text: I'm sorry, but your plane home just flew out without you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is there a way to catch the next flight?

The airline attendant types on the computer and turns the screen around.

nodes.speaker: Airline Agent
nodes.text: New tickets back will be approximately this much.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's more than my allowance for like a year!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Where are we going to get the money for that?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: When I wanted to get money, my parents talked to me about getting a job!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just because you're a bellhop doesn't mean you have to hop everywhere, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know. But it's just so fun! Hop, hop, hop...

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.text: The next morning, everyone meets in the hotel lobby.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now that everyone's gotten some sleep, we're going to go down and build houses for W.H.A.L.E...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, that sounds boring.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That sounds like hard labor.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know, it sounds like it could be fun.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm sure with all of us helping, it'll go by quickly.
Some hours and a couple houses later...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whew! Glad that's over.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: See? What'd I tell you? It went by so fast!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Good work, everyone! You should all be very proud of yourselves. Anyone who wants to join W.H.A.L.E. for future...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, we did our good deed.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's go to the beach!
Down at the beach...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So if we keep constant record of the waves' movements, we should be able to figure out the exact gravitational pull of the celestial bodies on the Earth's tides.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You mean, we can figure out the `motion of the ocean?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, we can figure out the [color=#e23b3b][i]motion of the ocean?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Or we can figure out patterns of oscillatory motion inherent to the waxing and waning of the oceans...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Justin, want to join us?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, Dex. I'm just going to be over here taking some pictures for the yearbook.
Justin moves away with his camera in tow. Elsewhere...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Want to spread some suntan lotion on my back before we get in the water?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do Level 2 Mages love getting the Staff of Awesomeness?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Tee-hee.
While others prefer something more exciting...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Whoo! The waves at this beach are `big!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoo! The waves at this beach are [color=#e23b3b][i]big![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Less mouth-flapping, more surfing. Prepare to eat ocean spray, sucker!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hah!
And some stick to the shallower waters to snorkel...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The water is so clear! You can see everything!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, I see yellow fish and red fish... But where are the dolphins?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A guide said they were on the other side of the island. Maybe we can go there later.
On the beach, $ZOE shyly dips a toe in the water.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's wrong, $ZOE? Aren't you going to come and snorkel with us?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to, but, well, it's kind of silly. I'm nervous about going into the water. I'm not a good swimmer, and I've never gone snorkeling before.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's pretty simple. Put the mask on, breathe through the tube, and look at fish.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Surely there's more to it than that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, the first thing you have to do is put your swim gear on...
Sam spends the next twenty minutes explaining snorkeling to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And finally, when you want to breathe, blow hard to get all the water out of your snorkel... That's it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you girls coming?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy, what's taking so long?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just a second!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, you ready?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I'm not sure I can go out there, Sam. What if I mess up?

options.label: Talk about the pretty marine life.
Remind her of her New Year's resolution.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Maybe that's true, but I can't let you...
Paige suddenly appears at the bouncer's side.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Excuse me? They're with me.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Lady, she just failed to get her facts straight on her ID.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Everyone makes mistakes. Maybe I can convince you to let it slide this one time?
Paige passes the bouncer money.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: It's your lucky day, Miss Flores. Step inside...
Sam, Colt, Howard, and $ZOE walk past the bouncer.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: All right, who's next?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We've got our `IDs`. Stan Danstand, December 28, 333 Street Road!
nodes.text_bbcode: We've got our [color=#e23b3b][i]IDs[/i][/color]. Stan Danstand, December 28, 333 Street Road!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Bonnie Petite, February 22, 911 Emergency Road!

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Ugh, you kids. Just go in. The whole lot of you.
Justin holds up a camera!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Mind if I take a picture of this moment? It's the first time I've ever been in a club!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You are so weird, Justin.
The Centerscore students walk inside.
Inside the club...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was worried we weren't going to make it in when Sam answered a question wrong!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks for saving us back there, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know how we're going to pay you back.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll think of something.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wonderful.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, let's start dancing!

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Oh, is that right? It doesn't say that on your fake ID.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I swear, it's me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to do that? Can't we just stick to dancing? Or, you know, something legal?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you think, `Sam`?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you think, [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, pretty please?
Paige and Sam join the cheerleaders on the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Taylor, we're dancing next to the cutest boys I've ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: There's just a special something about older guys...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know, right? We should make it to all the fraternity events!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good job, Random Monarch Prep girl.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks!
In another corner of the room...
$Scott looks at different hats from around the world lined on the wall.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey Anj, get a load of this decor. Why would anyone possibly need this many hats?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I think it's neat! They're from all over the world... Berets from France, salakots from the Philippines, and tartan tam o' shanters from Scotland!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That doesn't really answer $Scott's question.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So many hats... So few dolphins.
And in another corner of the club, $USR comes up to Howard!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Hey, Howard! You're in Hawaii?

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Hah, dumb question. How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $USR! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: I'm helping the MAN fraternity win the title of Kings of Spring Break! We're competing against DUDE.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: But that's a different story. What are `you` doing `here?`
nodes.text_bbcode: But that's a different story. What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing [color=#e23b3b][i]here?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're on a school trip!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Ha ha, awesome. When I was at Centerscore, we didn't do anything nearly as fun as go to Hawaii. Hope you're all enjoying yourselves...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Anyway, I have to go supervise. I'll catch you guys later!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Bye, $USR!
And back in the middle of the room...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm bored. Dancing's fun, and the guys are cute. But I want to do something exciting!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Exciting'?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Something risky. Something daring! Oh, I got it! We should steal one of Club Luau's hats!
Paige points to a large sombrero hanging on a bull's head on the wall.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know if I want to steal a hat.
A short while later, Sam and $ZOE are just settling down to sleep when there's a knock at the door! $ZOE opens it to find Hector, Howard, and Colt!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Guys, have you seen Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's not with you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, obviously! She's gone. Poof! Vamonos! Vavoom into thin air!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, I'm not sure that means what you think...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whatever, man! We've been looking for her forever. We checked her room, the entire downstairs, and the gym. We've even checked every shiny object and glitter store from the club and back again!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who knew so many glitter stores would be open past midnight?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When was the last time you saw her?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: At the club. Then I lost track of her and have been looking everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You sure she didn't just lock herself in a closet or something?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's only done that twice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, Hector. I'm sure she's in the hotel. We'll split up and look for her.
They all search the hotel from top to bottom. Half an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Did you find her?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, not anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What if she's been kidnapped?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sure she's fine, Hector. We just have to think about where she'd go. Maybe she went to the mall?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What about a bathroom? Would she have locked herself in one of those? A car?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, you're not helping.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Poor Amanda. She's all by herself. Probably scared and confused. More confused, but still.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Think, Sam... Where would Amanda go? What would she want to do in Hawaii?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, I got it! Hector, there's no need to panic. I know where she is. She went...

nodes.text: The clerk escorts the students to the penthouse where they turn in for the night.
A couple hours later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where do I go now, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then you, um, make a right, and we'll be right on the road to the airport...
Howard makes the right but stops the car shortly after the turn.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, Sam... This isn't the airport!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? What's wrong? And why's it so dark outside?
Sam throws open the car door and steps out...
Into a wintry wonderland!
Taylor gets out of the car behind Howard's.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sam! Where `are` we?! Where did you bring us?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam! Where [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] we?! Where did you bring us?

nodes.text: Sam sees a sign at the end of the road.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Guys, I think we're in Canada...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How could this have happened?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, we weren't paying attention. $ZOE was taking a nap, and I just zoned out listening to music.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I guess I was just focused on your driving directions.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: At least I can visit my girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut up, Keith. You're not allowed to be happy if all of us are `cold` and `miserable!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut up, Keith. You're not allowed to be happy if all of us are [color=#3b78e2][i]cold[/i][/color] and [color=#3b78e2][i]miserable![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The entire class ended up in Canada? This is not the sunny and fun vacation that Sam and $ZOE wanted!
Next time see if you can get Sam and the rest of the class on that trip to Hawaii!!
Let's try that again!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're staying in the penthouse of a luxurious, five-star, beach-side resort with awesome balconies and a view of the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Oh yeah? We're staying in a mansion.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But not in rooms with an ocean-side view! Prissy, I don't even think your estate faces the water at all!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, a beach house that doesn't face the beach? How lame.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not sure you can even call that a `beach house`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not sure you can even call that a [color=#e23b3b][i]beach house[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Fine, I guess your resort's not totally pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I, uh, just changed my name?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just moved recently!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I got distracted. I know I was born in late June!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on! Didn't you say you wanted to pay me back? I'm calling in a favor.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And we got to stay in an awesome suite!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks so much for convincing me to snorkel. I loved seeing all the fish.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe I used a fake ID to get into a club to make Paige happy.
In fact, you were perfect! Here's your bonus scene!
Find out how some of the other students at Centerscore High enjoyed their spring break in Hawaii!
On a basketball court at the hotel...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Pass it here, Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No problem, Kim!
Mallika shoots... And scores!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah! Your form is looking really good.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I've been working on it. Ever since the boys' basketball team has begun stepping it up.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But we're not competing with them.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Still have to look better.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ha ha. I like your spirit.
And on the beach on the other side of the island....

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Come on in! The water's fine!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know Dinah... That water looks kind of toxic...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Have I led you astray in all the times we've played Warscrewdriver Online together?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Jump into Lake Elysium, and it'll not only heal you, but repair all your equipment!
Brendan makes his Paladin jump into the lake.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ahh... This is the life. My bikini-clad girlfriend on my left, my fruity drink on my right, and my laptop on my lap!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: All right there, nerd.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh. I love you, Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I love you too.
Dinah kisses Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Can we get in the `actual` water now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Can we get in the [color=#3b78e2][i]actual[/i][/color] water now?

nodes.text: And at the main beach, the rebels race RVs in the sand!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Go, go, go!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Eat my dust, cuz!
Megan and Kenji race neck and neck until...
Megan wins!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Ugh, you won. Now I'll never hear the end of it.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What was that? You lost again? That makes it three races that I've won now?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Big talk, Megan, big talk.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I saw your last turn, Kenji. You can't take a sharp curve at that speed on sand.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Just some advice for the next time I cream you on the track! Best out of five?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You're on.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Let's roll!
Kim and Mallika are playing basketball? Brendan's doing online gaming? Kenji and Megan are racing? Who would've thought?
So maybe some students don't change their ways when on vacation... But at least they're having fun!
